changelog:
0.1.1

  • Stores tab: copy-to-clipboard icon beside each store's VIEW link — one click copies the full store URL. Shows a green check for 1.5s to confirm.
  • Works in the table view and the mobile card view; falls back to execCommand on non-secure contexts.

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin release — full port of the BT-Sched WPCode snippets (DB + crons, REST API, [bt_schedule] frontend, head CSS).
  • All PHP functions renamed btp_* so the plugin can coexist with the snippets during cutover.
  • Admin status page with update check.
  • Self-updater via GitHub manifest.
